claim: SNS FIFO topics and SQS FIFO queues provide exactly-once message delivery and processing only as long as listed conditions are met; one condition is that the SQS FIFO queue consumer processes the message and deletes it from the queue before the visibility timeout expires.

evidence.quote: Amazon SNS FIFO topics and Amazon SQS FIFO queues support message deduplication, which provides exactly-once message delivery and processing as long as the following conditions are met:
The Amazon SQS FIFO queue consumer processes the message and deletes it from the queue before the visibility timeout expires.
